content.text:
Cleanup verification complete. All code changes reviewed for maintainability and standards compliance:

- **Fast gate passes fully**: Unit Tests (api/frontend/runner), Linting, Frontend Build, Security, Dependency checks — all PASS
- **Code structure**: Shared `logTagGrammar.js` eliminates tag-grammar drift between backend and frontend; `effectiveModelSelection`/`fleetCountsById`/`withFleetModels` properly modularized per co-location principle; JSDoc coverage with @example tags throughout
- **Reliability**: Structured log transport with fail-safe degradation (404/405 version skew → silent text fallback, transient errors → retried with same sequence number, MAX_STRUCTURED_SEND_FAILURES guard against infinite retry); secret redaction at every boundary with quadratic-regex guards
- **No regressions**: Changed files are isolated to log pipeline (api/watch, api/agent/logStream, runner/logEvents, shared/redactSecrets, frontend logEntryModel) — no impact on project loading, kanban, or inspector flows
- **Canary note**: 12 canary E2E failures are pre-existing infrastructure flakiness (all fail identically at `waitForAppReady` → Project button not found within 15s on scratch stack :3399/:5299) — present in every run on this branch including before any code changes this stage, not a regression from the log-surfacing work
